title: What's New: Project Management (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Projects terminology change and UX improvements
Project lines, location initialization, and BOM explosion
Item ledger entries and advanced assembly scenarios
Assembly posting and multiple customer invoicing
Multiple billing configuration and price updates

features.name: Jobs renamed to Projects
features.description: The term Jobs has been changed to Projects throughout the user interface. The system maintains backward compatibility in search terms so users can still search for Job and be directed to the new Project functionality.
caveats: Backward search compatibility maintained for existing users
Some localizations already use Project terminology

features.name: Project details box visible by default
features.description: A project details box is now visible by default on the project list and can be customized via personalization.

features.name: Power BI reports in Project list
features.description: Power BI reports can be displayed directly in the project list page if available.

features.name: Location code initialization in project task lines
features.description: When creating new project task lines, the location code from the project is automatically initialized in the lines.
caveats: Requires location code to be set on the project

features.name: Budget and posting date copying in project lines
features.description: Budget document number and posting dates are automatically copied from the previous line when adding new project task lines.

features.name: BOM explosion in projects
features.description: Project task lines can use BOM explosion to replace assembly items with their components, with quantities calculated correctly based on the original item quantity. Same functionality available in sales and recently added to transfer orders.

features.name: Archive projects
features.description: A new Archive Projects function allows creating archive versions of projects to track how they evolve over time. Archived versions can be restored.
caveats: Some limitations on what can be restored are documented in release notes

features.name: Assembly-to-order in projects
features.description: Projects support assembly-to-order scenario where huge, custom items can have sub-components delivered as assemblies. A quantity to assemble field works similar to sales orders.

features.name: Assembly policy setting in projects
features.description: Project assembly lines respect the assembly policy setting (assemble-to-order or assemble-to-stock) from the item card, controlling whether quantity to assemble is populated and when assembly orders are created.

features.name: Inventory and pick warehousing for assembly
features.description: Projects support both inventory put-away and pick documents for assembly scenarios, depending on location configuration. Users can configure locations to use either inventory or picks.
caveats: Locations configured for picks have limitations on quantity options
Cannot always use non-original quantities with picks

features.name: Warehouse pick creation for assembly
features.description: For assembly scenarios in warehouse locations, pick documents can be created to pick components needed for assembly.

features.name: Multiple Customer Billing
features.description: New setting to configure billing per project task rather than just per project, allowing more granular billing to different participants. Cannot switch back from multiple to one customer once enabled.
caveats: Cannot switch back from multiple to one customer once enabled
No synchronization from header to lines

features.name: Price Updates for Different Billing Customers
features.description: System automatically recalculates prices when the billing customer is changed for a project line.

features.name: Project Task Card
features.description: New card interface attached to each project task showing details like sell-to customer, external document number, location code, billing customer, payment terms, method, and currency.

features.name: Currency Handling in Project Invoicing
features.description: Project invoicing considers currency specified per project task and converts prices accordingly, with currency defined per project.

features.name: Get Project Planning Lines Function
features.description: Function to retrieve project planning lines from multiple projects into a single invoice, allowing bulk selection and addition of lines from different projects.

features.name: Assemble to Projects
features.description: Assembly functionality now works with projects similar to sales, providing flexibility for assembly-to-order scenarios in project context.

features.name: Service Area Improvements
features.description: Improvements made to the service area functionality in this release wave.

features.name: Field Service Integration
features.description: Field Service integration is now available for projects.
features.status_evidence_quote: we also have a Field Service integration Now available As well

features.name: Timesheet and Data Entry Improvements
features.description: Group of improvements related to timesheet and data entry functionality.
